div.div: Q. Q. 3 إِكْلَنْدَى He (a man, Lh, and a camel, S, L) was, or became, thick, big, gross, or coarse, and strong; (Lh, S, L, K;) like إِعْلَنْدَى; (S, L;) as also ↓ إِكْلَنْدَدَ (Lh, L) and ↓ تَكَلَّدَ : (K:) he, or it, was, or became, hard; (K;) and strong; as also ↓ إِكْلَنْدَدَ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
